children: The partnership connects Polymath's purpose-built tokenization technology with High Ridge Trust's regulated financial infrastructure to support institutional participation in tokenized markets.

TORONTO, Sept. 11, 2026 /CNW/ -- Polymath Research Inc., a provider of enterprise-grade infrastructure for regulated digital securities and tokenized financial instruments, today announced a partnership with High Ridge Trust, a regulated U.S. trust company focused on institutional digital assets.

The partnership brings together complementary capabilities: Polymath's technology for the issuance, compliance, and lifecycle management of regulated digital securities and High Ridge Trust's regulated financial infrastructure for institutional digital assets.  Together, the companies aim to connect tokenization technology with the security, transparency, and institutional controls needed to support broader participation in tokenized markets. According to Natalie Hirsch, Chief Financial Officer of Polymath:

"Tokenization becomes far more powerful when technology and regulated financial infrastructure work together."High Ridge shares our belief that the next generation of capital markets will require blockchain technology and traditional financial safeguards to operate within a connected ecosystem.
This partnership is an important step toward delivering the infrastructure needed for tokenization to reach institutional scale."

The partnership will enable High Ridge Trust to bring the full breadth of its institutional digital asset capabilities to tokenized assets, including custody, client-directed trading and, as the market continues to evolve, access to potential yield opportunities. According to Karen Wendel, President and Chief Executive Officer of High Ridge Trust:
"Institutional adoption of tokenization requires more than technology.

It requires regulated financial infrastructure, clear responsibilities and controls designed for the realities of digital assets. Polymath brings technology built specifically for regulated securities.
High Ridge Trust brings regulated financial infrastructure for institutional digital assets. Together, we aim to make participation in tokenized markets more practical for institutions."

The companies intend to identify technical and operational initiatives that draw on their respective platforms, capabilities, and market relationships, intending to create a more connected experience for institutions participating in tokenized markets.

The collaboration comes as Polymath enters a significant new growth phase.  On August 18, 2026, Polymath announced an agreement to be acquired by TruGolf Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRUG), a transaction intended to bring Polymath's purpose-built blockchain and tokenization infrastructure to the U.S. public markets, subject to customary closing conditions.

Together, Polymath and High Ridge Trust aim to help bridge traditional financial markets and blockchain-based infrastructure, combining purpose-built digital securities technology with the regulated institutional framework needed to support the continued growth of tokenized capital markets.
About Polymath

Polymath is a privately held Canadian technology company that develops enterprise-grade capital markets infrastructure for the issuance, compliance, and lifecycle management of regulated digital securities and other tokenized financial instruments for private and institutional markets.

Polymath enables issuers, investors, and market participants to create and manage tokenized representations of real-world assets within compliant frameworks, supporting investor onboarding, regulatory controls, and post-issuance administration.

On August 18, 2026, Polymath entered into an agreement to be acquired by TruGolf Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRUG).  The transaction is expected to bring Polymath's purpose-built blockchain and tokenization infrastructure to the public markets and remains subject to customary closing conditions.
About High Ridge Trust

High Ridge Trust is a regulated U.S. trust company focused on institutional digital assets.  Its platform is designed around security, regulatory alignment, transparency, and institutional-grade controls.  High Ridge Trust works with financial institutions, corporations, funds, and other organizations participating in digital asset markets.
